schema.name: consultation
schema.description: Manages WhatsApp consultation records, including target person's details, status, and reports.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for each data of this entity.

compliance.reason: Public unique identifier for the consultation record.

fields.name: data_creator
fields.description: id of the user who creates the record

compliance.reason: Internal user identifier for auditing purposes. Represents the userId.

fields.name: data_updater
fields.description: id of the user who updates the record

compliance.reason: Internal user identifier for auditing purposes.
Internal metadata for tracking creation time.
Internal metadata for tracking update time.

fields.name: user_name
fields.description: Name of the user who initiated the consultation.

compliance.reason: Contains the user's name, which is Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full name of the target person for the consultation.

compliance.reason: Contains the target person's name, which is Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Phone number of the target person for the consultation.

compliance.reason: Contains the target person's phone number, which is Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

fields.name: address
fields.description: Full address of the target person.

compliance.reason: Contains the target person's address, which is Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

fields.name: cep
fields.description: Postal code (CEP) of the target person's address.

compliance.reason: Contains the target person's location data, which is Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country of the target person's address.

compliance.reason: Contains the target person's location data, which is Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

fields.name: city
fields.description: City of the target person's address.

compliance.reason: Contains the target person's location data, which is Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

fields.name: neighborhood
fields.description: Neighborhood of the target person's address.

compliance.reason: Contains the target person's location data, which is Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
Internal operational data for tracking consultation lifecycle.

fields.name: report_data
fields.description: Contains the webhook response data as a JSON string.

compliance.reason: Report data may contain sensitive information from the consultation.
